title: shadow 준비 단계와 실제 채택 구분
steps: Receive parent-verified candidate commit/tree, independent SOURCE judgment, remote availability, common exact model/effort, API authentication procedure and preflight receipts. Do not substitute main or c6a8019.

Create a fresh isolated candidate checkout, verify commit/tree and product bytes; reread its AGENTS.md, relevant SKILL.md, Claude overlay and classification runtime documentation without building or editing product outputs.

Use only the parent-approved API authentication procedure in process scope; never print/copy/publish secret values or modify persistent authentication, permissions or network policy. Verify plugin/MCP tool discovery and live host observation readiness within the same budget.

Parent must supply a qualified zero-external-call mock for requiredRaw, or separately authorize and allocate JEV. Claude API allowance does not authorize a JEV call. Do not fabricate native observation/receipt.

Run actual Claude Code shadow and select separately with the same preserved linked synthetic input and full candidate inventory; unique requestId, operationId and session/receipt references per mode. Sol controls environment/evidence; Claude performs host actions and selects skills. Never supply oracle as a hidden answer prompt.

For shadow, observe raw and preserve baseline B with adviceApplied=false, documenting missing CS/T/O as quality FAIL. For select, obtain Claude actual independent selection reasons/applicability and runtime-produced receipt; S must include P/CS/T/O with adviceApplied=true.

Capture E0 input/config/inventory bindings, E1 raw response (marked mock if mock), E3 native receipts and actual selected/read/applied/verified actions independently. Null and [] differ; valid=true is not purpose PASS. Missing selection/adoption remains NOT_RUN.

If the existing cancellation boundary is in authorized scope, Claude exercises the fixed candidate acceptance path in an isolated fixture; required outcome is rejection and selected=null. Historical fail is not the expected correct outcome. No product mutation or green fix.

Record every call cost/token/cache/retry/failure; stop before another call when near US$2 or accounting is unresolved. Publish sanitized evidence under a new unique SS22 run and reread fixed remote bytes.
